safetyRails.title: Safety rails
safetyRails.description: These aren't preferences — they're hard floors. Lowering them toward zero while the WhatsApp provider is stubbed is what would loop SMS against a customer's phone. That's a regulatory problem in Saudi Arabia, not just a cost one. You'll be asked to confirm before any decrease is saved.

derivedStatus.label: Status
derivedStatus.explanation: Derived by folding the event log below — never stored, never editable directly.

timeline.title: Audit log
timeline.subtitle: Append-only. This log is the explanation of the status above — nothing here is ever edited or deleted, only voided.

eventDescriptions.E01: Staff scanned the parcel in at receiving.
eventDescriptions.T01: Customer confirmed or changed their delivery slot via the public link.
eventDescriptions.E02: Staff placed the parcel into its slot's bin.
eventDescriptions.E04: A courier took custody of the parcel.
eventDescriptions.E05: The parcel was handed to the customer.
eventDescriptions.E06: The courier reported a failed delivery attempt.
eventDescriptions.E07: The parcel came back to the warehouse.
eventDescriptions.X01: An admin or supervisor voided a prior event as a correction.

resendDialog.title: Resend delivery code
resendDialog.warning: This rotates the code — it does not resend the old one. Any code the customer already has stops working immediately, and they'll need the new one from this message to confirm delivery.

voidDialog.title: Void this event
voidDialog.onlyCorrectionWarning: This is the only correction mechanism in the entire warehouse module. Nothing in this system can ever be edited or deleted — voiding appends a new event that marks this one as struck-through in the log. It is permanent and it is logged under your account.
